mentions.name: exe.dev file systems work
mentions.description: File systems work at exe.dev, starting with copy-on-write VM cloning built on existing software, plus a rethink of the standard cloud approach of putting everything on a NAS by default, which the team believes is wrong and will require doing unusual things.
mentions.problem: The team believes the standard cloud approach of putting everything on a NAS by default is wrong.
mentions.source_excerpt: In particular, we are spending a lot of time on file systems. The easy one is copy-on-write VM cloning, which existing software provides for us. More interestingly, I believe the standard cloud approach of putting everything on a NAS by default is wrong.
